answer.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe.Person_Identifier) AS female_policyholders
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" apr
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" po
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party" pa

JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."person" pe

WHERE (apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'ph%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%holder%' OR apr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE '%policy%')
  AND pe.Gender_Code = 1
LIMIT 501

failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: every filter literal ("1") is bound in the executed query
the time window 2019-01-01..2020-01-01 is bound in the executed query
executed on the warehouse: 2 rows in 1 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT
  policy
  , policy__policy_number
  , SUM(total_policy_amount) AS total_policy_amount
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', policy_amount_src_10000.effective_date) AS metric_time__day
    , policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Identifier AS policy
    , subq_3.has_premium AS policy_amount__has_premium
    , policy_src_10000.policy_number AS policy__policy_number
    , policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Amount AS total_policy_amount
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" policy_amount_src_10000
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      Policy_Amount_Identifier AS policy_amount
      , 1 AS has_premium
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" premium_src_10000
  ) subq_3
  ON
    policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Amount_Identifier = subq_3.policy_amount
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" policy_src_10000
  ON
    policy_amount_src_10000.Policy_Identifier = policy_src_10000.Policy_Identifier
) subq_8
WHERE (
  policy_amount__has_premium = 1
) AND (
  metric_time__day >= '2019-01-01'
) AND (
  metric_time__day < '2020-01-01'
)
GROUP BY
  policy
  , policy__policy_number

answer.sql:
SELECT
  policy__party_identifier_dim
  , SUM(number_of_policies) AS number_of_policies
FROM (
  SELECT
    agreement_party_role_src_10000.party_identifier AS policy__party_identifier_dim
    , agreement_party_role_src_10000.party_role_code AS policy__party_role_code
    , subq_1.__number_of_policies AS number_of_policies
  FROM (
    SELECT
      Policy_Identifier AS policy
      , 1 AS __number_of_policies
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" policy_src_10000
  ) subq_1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
    "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" agreement_party_role_src_10000
  ON
    subq_1.policy = agreement_party_role_src_10000.agreement_identifier
) subq_5
WHERE policy__party_role_code = 'AG'
GROUP BY
  policy__party_identifier_dim
ORDER BY number_of_policies DESC
LIMIT 1
